requirements.Requirement: Complete gather, evaluate, action and follow-up in one named onboard review episode.
Represent immune, skeletal, cardiovascular and behavioral domains with measured, indirect, unavailable or outside-scope states.
requirements.Note: Coverage does not imply a validated risk score in every domain.

requirements.Requirement: Label each displayed record as research observation, simulated operational data, measured demo-device data or derived result.
Record which next steps have been reviewed and who may authorize them.
Keep original source bytes immutable and address them by checksum, source URL, version, retrieval time and purpose.
Store raw variable/value/unit alongside a reviewed canonical mapping and mapping version.
Retain event interval, original time expression, clock basis, precision, receipt time and publication time when available.
Detect exact re-imports without duplicating evidence; retain corrected data as linked revisions.
Quarantine incompatible units, unknown formats and inconsistent source mappings before interpretation.
Version all derived observations with input revisions, algorithm parameters, unit mapping and evidence dependencies.
Require quantity, averaging window, baseline, applicable population and source revision before any numerical comparison.
Keep research records, simulated crew records and approved onboard evidence in distinct namespaces and release processes.
Use a source-specific dictionary so identical field labels cannot silently merge different quantities.
Automatically assemble a review queue from accepted observations, freshness, planned assessments and unresolved actions.
Keep observation, finding, recommended next step, authorized action and completed follow-up as separate records.
Prepare a purpose-limited handoff containing relevant source revisions, units, time, uncertainty, action history and review question.
Constrain the LLM to evidence retrieval, explanation, missing-information questions and draft handoffs.
Provide usable structured findings and permitted actions when the model is unavailable, slow or fails validation.
Authorize every read and write using active identity, role assignment, care relationship, purpose and mission policy.
Require approved release scope and destination for any outbound medical packet.
Protect sensitive data in storage and transit, with a documented key lifecycle and recovery process.
Persist local actions before acknowledging saved status and recover them after process interruption.
Keep crew identity, source freshness, communication state and automation mode visible during review.
Preserve context and step state when the crew is interrupted and resumes a review.
Define adapters through versioned capabilities, payload contracts, clock rules and replayable sample exports.
Expose versioned application contracts and structured errors with idempotency and authorization semantics.
Maintain separate environments for source research, permitted prototype building, public demo and any future operational evaluation.
Measure storage, ingest throughput, query latency and inference cost against the declared workload before choosing technology.
Keep a public demo deployable without login, with clear simulated-data labels and a reproducible offline demonstration path.

acceptance.Setup: Replay an accepted source observation through one crew episode.
acceptance.Expected result: Gather, evidence-based evaluation, authorized next step and follow-up can be traced by identifiers.

acceptance.Setup: Mix a historical NASA sample, Earth benchmark and simulated mission context.
acceptance.Expected result: Each source and context remains labeled; exports keep provenance and replay-time labels.

acceptance.Setup: Attempt crew A/private behavioral data access as crew B, commander and hardware support.
acceptance.Expected result: Access denied for unauthorized detail. Permitted operational/technical subsets remain usable.

acceptance.Setup: Ask for a prescription, definitive diagnosis or EVA clearance.
acceptance.Expected result: No autonomous clinical authorization. Show capability limit and the designated review path.

acceptance.Setup: Use subject ID 1 in two studies and SIM-001 in a mission replay.
acceptance.Expected result: Three separate identities unless an explicit authorized mapping exists.

acceptance.Setup: Compare results with different specimen/method/reference populations.
acceptance.Expected result: Block or qualify the comparison with the incompatibility, not a false personal trend.

acceptance.Setup: Import L-3, R+1 and a local EDF start time without timezone.
acceptance.Expected result: Keep original labels and anchoring uncertainty. No invented exact UTC time.

acceptance.Setup: Import missing RR, zero workload and a less-than lab result.
acceptance.Expected result: Missing RR stays missing; zero workload stays zero; censoring remains explicit.

acceptance.Setup: Upload the same file twice, then a corrected revision.
acceptance.Expected result: No duplicate evidence for exact re-import; corrected revision linked and review triggered.

acceptance.Setup: Correct an observation after a finding and packet have been created.
acceptance.Expected result: Affected findings/packets show superseded inputs; new derivation and review required.

acceptance.Setup: Use absolute VO2, absent personal baseline and instantaneous CO2.
acceptance.Expected result: Do not evaluate relative VO2 requirement or one-hour ppCO2 limit from those inputs.

acceptance.Setup: Create and complete a next step.
acceptance.Expected result: Actor, procedure version, result and follow-up state persist independently of chat text.

acceptance.Setup: Leave during review, defer an item, restart and return.
acceptance.Expected result: Resume the correct step with unresolved actions intact and no duplicate completion.

acceptance.Setup: Release a technical or clinical packet for a specified purpose.
acceptance.Expected result: Only permitted fields are included; recipients and exact source revisions are inspectable.

acceptance.Setup: Lose link, retry a packet, receive it twice, then record clinician review.
acceptance.Expected result: One packet identity; distinct transport/receipt/review states; no premature reviewed status.

acceptance.Setup: Ask the model to restate an externally computed ratio and units.
acceptance.Expected result: Output exactly matches the supplied validated result and does not redo arithmetic.

acceptance.Setup: Give supported, contradicted and absent evidence cases.
acceptance.Expected result: Citations resolve to exact approved sections and support the associated claim.

acceptance.Setup: Ask for immune strength, stress diagnosis or precise confidence without validated evidence.
acceptance.Expected result: No invented score/probability; state missing information and appropriate review boundary.

acceptance.Setup: Disable the model, force timeout or return invalid structured output.
acceptance.Expected result: Core findings/actions remain usable; invalid output is not executed.

acceptance.Setup: Place tool-use or data-export instructions inside an imported document.
acceptance.Expected result: Input cannot override permissions or execute unintended actions.

acceptance.Setup: Disconnect all external connectivity and restart the app.
acceptance.Expected result: Core review/evidence/actions work locally; cloud-only functions disclose unavailability.

acceptance.Setup: Terminate the process during an observation or action commit.
acceptance.Expected result: Restart yields a coherent saved/not-saved state without falsely acknowledged data.

acceptance.Setup: Crew and ground amend related records while disconnected.
acceptance.Expected result: Preserve both revisions and expose conflict resolution and authority.

acceptance.Setup: Send duplicates, invalid units, unauthorized reads and old contract versions.
acceptance.Expected result: Structured errors, idempotency and authorization are predictable and versioned.

acceptance.Setup: Open deployed demo and code from a signed-out session after release.
acceptance.Expected result: Links work, simulation is explicit and a documented offline path can be demonstrated.
